annotations.title: Check if an MCP server is safe (free)

description: [Private query, public score] Is this MCP server safe to connect? FREE, no signup: we connect to any public MCP URL and report its permissions, risky tools, prompt-injection signs and changes since the last check. Example: serverUrl='https://example.com/mcp'. For a free JSON preview of the 0.25 USDC full dossier, call get_trust_dossier_sample.

paymentRecoveryToken.description: Required with paymentTxHash. Generate a private random 32-byte token as 64 hex characters before the first paid request. Reuse it with the same transaction and server URL to retry or retrieve the report without paying again.

paymentTxHash.description: Optional. Base USDC tx hash: 0.02 USDC = extra check after 5 free/day, 0.25 USDC = full 7-question dossier with HMAC seal.

serverUrl.description: Public https URL of the MCP server to check.

name: check_mcp_server_trust
